title: Wednesday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The framing shop. Foam core. Gully with two sacks. No reference to Monday or Tuesday. The strip never mentions Seattle again.

panels.composition: The frame shop backroom, Small Wood. WOOD cutting foam core with the dull utility knife. Exactly as before.

image.prompt: a young man in a chore coat cutting foam core with a dull utility knife in a cluttered picture-framing backroom, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: GULLY in the side door with two grease sacks. Rain.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap leaning in a shop side door holding up two grease-stained paper sacks in the rain

panels.composition: Wood, taking one. Not looking up. Nothing on his face about anything.

characters.pose: taking a sack, not looking up

image.prompt: close-up of a young man taking a paper sack without looking up from his work, expressionless

panels.composition: The alley. Two spackle buckets. Two men eating clams in silence. Rain. Same as ever. The strip never says Seattle again.

image.prompt: two young men sitting on upturned spackle buckets in a narrow rain alley eating from paper sacks in silence, black and white, no words
image.notes: The leak. Tuesday's clams: he was here Tuesday.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Tuesday's. They held up.' — the strip's own evidence against Monday and Tuesday. Nobody in the strip notices.
